name: Malayan Banking Berhad (Maybank)
oneLine: Malaysia's largest bank and listed company, with big operations in Singapore and Indonesia plus insurance and takaful (Etiqa).
inPlainWords: Maybank takes deposits and lends to individuals, small businesses and large companies, mainly in Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia.
About two-thirds of its loans are in Malaysia, where it lends close to one in five ringgit of all bank loans.
Islamic banking (Maybank Islamic) is a large part of the business, and it also sells insurance and takaful through Etiqa.
It employs over 43,000 people across the group (FY2025 integrated report part 1 p30).

flow.label: Depositors
flow.detail: Customers place savings and deposits with the bank, which pays them interest.

flow.label: The bank
flow.detail: It lends that money out as home, car, personal and business loans at a higher rate.

flow.label: Borrowers
flow.detail: Borrowers repay with interest; the gap between the two rates is the bank's main income.

flow.label: Fees
flow.detail: It also earns fees from cards, wealth products, insurance sales and transactions.

segments.name: Community Financial Services
segments.desc: Loans, deposits, cards and wealth for individuals and small businesses

segments.name: Corporate Banking and Global Markets
segments.desc: Loans, cash management and treasury for large companies

segments.name: Insurance and Takaful (Etiqa)
segments.desc: Life, general and family takaful insurance

segments.name: Investment Banking
segments.desc: Share broking, deal advice and capital raising (Maybank Investment Bank)

segmentNote: Revenue is net income (after paying depositors); profit is profit before tax by segment (Q2 FY2026 report p.57). Head office and others (a net cost of RM377.7m in 1H2026) is left out of the split.
